title: WOWW: Add fields to several message types
description:
This PR adds fields for the following messages for the 1.12 version:

* CMSG_AUTH_SESSION
* CMSG_CHAR_CREATE
* CMSG_CHAR_DELETE
* CMSG_CHAR_RENAME
* CMSG_NAME_QUERY
* CMSG_PING
* CMSG_PLAYER_LOGIN
* CMSG_SET_ACTIVE_MOVER
* CMSG_SET_SELECTION
* SMSG_AUTH_CHALLENGE
* SMSG_AUTH_RESPONSE
* SMSG_CHARACTER_LOGIN_FAILED
* SMSG_CHAR_CREATE
* SMSG_CHAR_DELETE
* SMSG_CHAR_ENUM
* SMSG_LOGIN_VERIFY_WORLD
* SMSG_NAME_QUERY_RESPONSE
* SMSG_PONG
* SMSG_TUTORIAL_FLAGS

Wiki references can be found at https://wowdev.wiki/MSG_NAME, like https://wowdev.wiki/CMSG_PING

The capture is combat, spellcasting and character creation/deletion from the Mangos server emulator. It is the closest thing available to the original Blizzard servers.

[wow-112-mangos-create-delete-combat.pcapng.gz](/uploads/66d88fcb08a66b5fa41770bb219a2652/wow-112-mangos-create-delete-combat.pcapng.gz)

___

I would also like to know what reviewer opinions are on creating a function macro like
```c
#define WOWW_ADD_TO_TREE(LENGTH, FIELD, ENCODING) { proto_tree_add_item(tree, hf_woww_build, tvb, offset, LENGTH, ENCODING); offset += LENGTH; }

// Usage
WOWW_ADD_TO_TREE(4, hf_woww_challenge_seed, ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN)
```

None of the other dissectors appear to use something like this, but it would cut down on the visual noise significantly, especially as the switch statement grows.

commits_data.message:
WOWW: Convert body fields to use `ptvcursor`

This significantly reduces boilerplate required for adding fields.

The changes to SMSG_CHAR_CREATE from ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN to ENC_NA are
intentional, as are the changes to CMSG_CHAR_RENAME from realm_name to
character_name.
